scope: The 105 previously unreviewed Inscription outputs: 60 glyphs, six buff scrolls, three utility or BoE items, 32 exact random Darkmoon cards, and four completed decks

rules.gold_scale: Fixed frozen Hellscream cohort anchors or qualified completed sales.
rules.recipe_floor_role: Exact audited 3.3.5 recipe cost is a separate craftability diagnostic and does not automatically set market value.
rules.random_card_rule: Darkmoon Card of the North creates one random card among 32 possible named outcomes; its input cost is a per-roll diagnostic, never a guaranteed exact-card floor.
rules.completed_deck_rule: Each completed deck consumes one of every rank in its eight-card set; saved card opportunity cost remains separate from deck sale value.
rules.book_baseline_rule: Book of Glyph Mastery stays at the user-estimated 2026-08-03 band of 12g 50s / 25g / 60g with the original 150g / 300g / 700g baseline recorded.
rules.sparse_sale_rule: Low-confidence completed sales receive 25% weight, or 50% when they span at least two buyers and two UTC days; the balance remains the reviewed cohort fallback.
rules.stackable_medium_gate: At least 12 units across four completed buyouts, two distinct buyers, and two distinct UTC days, with largest-buyer unit share at most 0.50.
rules.one_at_a_time_medium_gate: At least four completed buyouts, two distinct buyers, and two distinct UTC days, with largest-buyer unit share at most 0.50.
rules.preserved_scope: Armor Vellum III and Weapon Vellum III retain their completed Phase 1B evidence and are excluded from this batch.
